content:
Composer microphone

Push-to-talk in the composer sends audio for transcription and fills the input (separate from the orb flow).

What this is

Composer microphone is push-to-talk: hold or click the mic in the composer, speak, release to send audio for transcription; text lands in the input field for editing before send.

How to use it

  • Grant microphone permission when the browser prompts.
  • Edit the transcript if words are wrong, then press send normally.
  • This path is separate from the full-screen voice orb loop.

Notes and limits

Poor network drops uploads; watch for inline errors and retry.
